descriptions.w3d_s20_refresh_handle_8013f2f8: Appears to resolve a stored handle, clearing it when stale and otherwise passing the object to a helper.
descriptions.w3d_s20_enable_slot_8016857c: Appears to pass a 64-byte slot and its bit to a helper and set that bit in the mask at offset 776.
descriptions.w3d_s20_construct_counted_80172b14: Appears to run a base constructor, install a vtable, clear a field, increment a global instance count and return this.
descriptions.w3d_s20_lookup_slot_8017ded8: Appears to look up a slot index for a key and return the word at that index of the table at offset 24, else 0.
descriptions.w3d_s20_notify_then_apply_801d6550: Appears to call a helper on the secondary base subobject with 3 and the item, then forward this and the item to another helper.
